text: 华灿光电公告，公司2026年度向特定对象发行股票申请于2026年9月30日获深圳证券交易所受理。深交所核对后认为申请文件齐备，决定予以受理。
text_en: HC Semitek announced that the company's application for a targeted issuance of shares to specific objects for 2026 was accepted by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on September 30, 2026. After review, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange deemed the application documents complete and decided to accept them.
